_about: Setup-wide slots that aren't an agent's skill. null = empty slot, waiting for a tool. Drawn in Vault/Projects/Claude_Setup/Setup_Diagram.md.

input-compression.tried: headroom 0.41 (2026-10-24/25): removed - a proxy in every request caused API outages; saved 0.2-1.4% in real sessions

recall-hook.about: off since 2026-11-19, his words: "i dont want lesson recall ... i dont want that for now and it should have also been mixed with the other on message hooks if anything". The gate's all-lessons check (output-gate) stays on

recall-all-lessons.about: the cheap model (brain.ask) sees ALL approved lessons on every call, in recall-hook (his message) and output-gate (the turn), and names those that apply, any number; only those reach the main session. Off = embedding search of candidates (retrieve.py/graph.py) plus the second filter, for when the lessons are too many to send each time (alllessons.LESSONS_MAX is the size warning)

decision-capture.about: on his message a cheap model detects a design decision and drafts a diary entry into diary-pending/ (local, never pushed); asked once at the next message; his yes -> decisions.py approve appends it to the project's diary (append-only)

flags-capture.about: on his next message, agent returns that name their own choices (Choices beyond the spec, ...) are extracted by a cheap model and appended to the project's DIARY_FLAGS.md under a dated Claude-on-its-own section, no approval, deduped by embedding; the setup's file is in the private vault

vision.about: VISION.md injected like a rule: printed first on every human message by hook.py, and added to every subagent's context by a SubagentStart hook (scripts/recall/vision.py)

delegation-hook.about: on his message, one cheap-model call says what kind of response he wants (yes/no, full answer, task to say back and confirm, confirm, talk) and prints one instruction line to the main session; also saves the setup snapshot; wording in tasks/delegation-draft.md. The output step is the separate slot delegation-gate

delegation-gate.about: the output gate's delegation blocks (tester, reviewer, knowledge-manager, setup-manager, loop); off 2026-11-19, owner: 'the gate will compare the work with my lessons and other than that yes'; on = the old behaviour

map-follows-sdd.about: a git post-commit hook in the SDD's repo (skills/sdd/scripts/sdd-hook.js, installed by install-hooks.js): a commit that changed an SDD redraws its map from that commit (sdd-to-map.js --commit) and commits it as its own commit; an SDD that fails the validator is never drawn

sdd-commit-check.about: a git pre-commit hook in the SDD's repo: a commit with an SDD that fails the validator is refused (a deliberate removal: SDD_REMOVED=id,id)

project-check.about: on the first message of a session, the project's five documents, its SDD format, its map's sddCommit and '(inferred)' in the diary are checked (projcheck.py); what is missing or stale is told to the owner once; nothing is fixed

short-returns.about: a SubagentStop hook (scripts/recall/shortreturn.py) blocks once an agent final message over 25 lines and asks for a short summary (done, errors, notes, own choices in one line); never twice, fails open; the long record is kept by the SDD/diary/flags hooks

test-limit.about: the owner's rule 2026-11-16: a test or eval run gets at most 1 minute, then the agent stops and asks him whether to continue. Hooks in scripts/testlimit.py: PreToolUse on Bash wraps a command that runs a test (a segment starting with `pattern`) in `timeout`; his short yes on his next message (UserPromptSubmit) approves re-running that exact cut command once, within 30 min

test-guard.about: the owner's rule: no test file without his approval. scripts/testguard.py: PreToolUse on Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit and Bash blocks a write into a path matching `pattern` (exit 2) unless this session has an approval; his short yes on his next message (UserPromptSubmit), after the agent's one-line `check: <what> — prevents <failure> — yes / ignore`, approves for `minutes`. Applies to subagents. Fails open on its own errors (state/test-guard.log)

graph-recall.about: cases as a graph (scripts/recall/graph.py): a case = a lesson node, each cases/history block = a path (situation, what was done, what he did not like). On: the recall hook matches his message against situation nodes and injects the traced path, the output gate matches the turn against what-was-done nodes and shows the past complaint to its brain, capture attaches a repeat to every lesson it matches instead of drafting a near-duplicate. Off = the flat retrieval. Measured by scripts/recall/eval_mechanism.py

shadow-select.about: on each gate call, after the real all-lessons check, the embedding path (retrieve.py, top-k, RELEVANCE_MIN, no model call) runs in shadow and one line goes to results/shadow_select.jsonl; `python -I scripts/recall/shadow.py report` compares it with what all-lessons named; never changes the verdict

work-learning.about: a detached background review (workreview.py) of the work since the last review, at his done (the message step's DONE) and every 10 human turns; drafts at most one lesson (source work) through patchfirst, so it reaches him only as the proposal line
